name: Replicate Image
author: hearth-team
description: Image generation via Replicate — one key, hundreds of community-hosted models (Flux, SDXL, ControlNet, inpaint/outpaint variants, background remover, upscalers). Pass `model` to pick a slug; defaults to black-forest-labs/flux-schnell. Single prompt → image saved to /dashboard/collateral.

family.name: AI Image Family
family.description: Headshots, inpainting, wardrobe swap, logos, social posts. Pick a provider (OpenAI / KIE / Higgsfield / Replicate / fal / Stability / Recraft / Ideogram) and your favorite task — sub-skills route through whichever provider you've configured.

vault_inputs.label: Replicate API Token
vault_inputs.help: From replicate.com → Account → API tokens. Starts with r8_… . Stored encrypted.
